verdict: ROAS holds steady, but purchase volume needs immediate attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5.53 for every $1 spent — a healthy efficiency number — but purchases dropped 33% in the most recent 7 days, and the last three days of the period saw very low purchase counts against consistent spend. The most likely cause is creative fatigue: your top campaign has been running to the same audience long enough that ad frequency has climbed to a point where it stops converting. At the same time, your Google Business Profile went dark on September 17–18, recording zero customer actions both days after averaging 25–47 actions per day earlier in the month — a drop that coincided with softer website traffic. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to address audience fatigue, and the Google Business Profile issue is being investigated to restore normal visibility.
